verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents a public API (DBX Platform) for creating, reading, editing, moving, and deleting files and folders through the Files API. It backs this with OAuth docs with customizable scopes, webhooks, and official SDKs in several languages, including a working JavaScript SDK example on GitHub. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths all 404), no markdown/LLM-friendly API docs (docs-md probe 404), and no independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
